redshift_cluster_address.description: Hostname of the Redshift cluster endpoint.

redshift_cluster_database_name.description: Initial database created on the cluster.

redshift_cluster_port.description: Port on which the Redshift cluster accepts connections.

redshift_cluster_subnet_group.description: Name of the Redshift subnet group providing endpoint access from two subnets.

redshift_cluster_subnet_ids.description: IDs of the two subnets (one per Availability Zone) that provide cluster endpoint access.

redshift_master_credentials_secret_arn.description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret holding the master credentials (created and rotated by Redshift).

description.constant_value: Redshift engine access restricted to the VPC CIDR and approved admin CIDRs

admin_cidr_blocks.description: Optional, tightly scoped admin CIDR blocks allowed to reach the Redshift port from outside the VPC. Must never include 0.0.0.0/0.

automated_snapshot_retention_period.description: Automated snapshot retention period in days (minimum 7).

cluster_type.description: Redshift cluster type: single-node or multi-node.

database_name.description: Name of the initial database created in the cluster.

master_username.description: Master username for the cluster (non-sensitive). The password itself is generated and rotated by Redshift in Secrets Manager.

number_of_nodes.description: Number of compute nodes (automatically forced to 1 when cluster_type is single-node).

project_name.description: Project name used as the naming prefix and Project tag.

subnet_a_cidr.description: CIDR block for the first Redshift subnet (AZ 1).

subnet_b_cidr.description: CIDR block for the second Redshift subnet (AZ 2).

tags.description: Common tags applied to every resource.

vpc_cidr.description: CIDR block for the dedicated Redshift VPC.
